    string s = tab;

    size_t p = s.find("at", 1);
    if (p != string::npos) s[p] = '@';

    vector<size_t> dots;

        regex r("dot(?=.)");
        auto cur = s.cbegin() + 1;

            dots.push_back((size_t)(m.position(0) + (cur - s.cbegin())));
            cur = m[0].second;

    for (size_t d : dots) s[d] = '.';

            ++i;
